title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E03 — Malama Ka Aina
An escalating gang war spills into the stands of a high-school football game, killing several people; an unlikely partnership arises.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E04 — Lanakila
A violent convict escapes from prison and kidnaps a young couple on vacation; McGarrett's estranged sister comes to town.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E05 — Nalowale
When the daughter of the U.S. ambassador to the Philippines is found dead, the governor tasks Five-0 with finding her abducted sister.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E06 — Ko'olauloa
When the CEO of a successful surf company is murdered, Kono revisits her past; Five-0 is thrown into the varied but interconnected worlds of North Shore surfing.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E07 — Ho'apono
A Navy SEAL accused of murder takes hostages and safe haven on a memorial battleship.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E08 — Mana'o
When Danny's ex-partner is found dead at a Hawaiian luau the Five-0 team's investigation leads them to some dirty cops and a powerful cocaine cartel.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E09 — Po'ipu
The team must protect a ruthless dictator from an assassination.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E04 — Windmill + Acetone + Celluloid + Firing Pin
As MacGyver works quickly to rescue survivors from a collapsed building in Germany, he discovers a new safety threat -- an undetonated bomb from World War II is hidden beneath the rubble.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E05 — Soccer + Desi + Merchant + Titan
In an attempt to find the main players in the Codex and cut off their match-fixing funding, Desi goes undercover to infiltrate a soccer team and find the corrupt player working with the shadow organization.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E06 — Right + Wrong + Both + Neither
When Russ' first love, Emilia, is kidnapped by the same rebels he fought during his private military contract days, he takes the Phoenix team to a small, impoverished town to rescue her and rid the town of the rebels for good.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E07 — Mac + Desi + Riley + Aubrey
A double date descends into chaos when Mac and Desi witness a murder in the back of the restaurant; as they work to find the killer, Riley tries to keep the secret about her and her friends' "day jobs" from her new boyfriend.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E08 — Father + Son + Father + Matriarch
After Oversight is almost killed in a bombing, he recruits Mac to help him find the suspected bomber; Mac meets his Aunt Gwendolyn.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E09 — Code + Artemis + Nuclear + N3mesis
Los Angeles' power grid is taken hostage in a ransomware attack resulting in a citywide blackout; the team discovers the ransomware code used was written by Riley years ago.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E10 — Tesla + Bell + Edison + Mac
When Mac is put into a dream state to help him recall key evidence found in Nikola Tesla's secret lab that could stop Codex's deadly plot, he encounters Nikola Tesla, Alexander Graham Bell, Thomas Edison and his mother.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E11 — Psy-Op + Cell + Merchant + Birds
Mac is placed inside a fake prison cell with a top Codex operative, "The Merchant," to gain his trust and get intel on their next move.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S08 E14 — All That Remains
When an author's daughter goes missing on the anniversary of his wife's disappearance, the team investigates the author as a possible suspect.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S08 E15 — Broken
The team heads to Austin to investigate when victims with watches set to inaccurate times are discovered; the team's stalker gets closer.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S08 E16 — Carbon Copy
Victims of the Replicator, the BAU's stalker, turn up in Philadelphia; the members of the team think they are getting close to apprehending their suspect.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S08 E17 — The Gathering
The team investigates victims who were sharing details about their personal lives and inner desires online; Kevin becomes jealous when he finds out that Garcia might have a new love interest.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S08 E18 — Restoration
When the team goes to Morgan's old neighborhood to track an UnSub targeting middle-aged men, Morgan suspects they are looking for someone connected to the man who abused him as a child.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S08 E19 — Pay It Forward
A 25-year-old time capsule opened in a small Colorado town reveals a gruesome discovery and a possible connection to a local police officer's death.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S08 E20 — Alchemy
The team heads to Rapid City when two men are murdered in a ritualistic way; Reid mourns Maeve's death.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S08 E21 — Nanny Dearest
The BAU team heads to Los Angeles in search of a suspect who kidnaps nannies and the children they care for.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S08 E22 — No. 6
The team tracks a suspect targeting people in Detroit; Blake receives a life-changing proposition from her husband (D.W. Moffett).

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S08 E23 — Brothers Hotchner
The team investigates a series of deaths in Manhattan that seem to be related to ecstasy overdoses; Hotch makes a discovery about his estranged brother.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S08 E24 — The Replicator
When the Replicator returns, a member of the BAU team is targeted.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S09 E01 — The Inspiration
The team tracks an increasingly devolving killer to Arizona; the team suspects Hotch is in the running to be the unit chief.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S09 E02 — The Inspired
As the hunt for a ritualistic killer continues, a bizarre familial connection could help the team zero in on the suspect.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S09 E03 — Final Shot
The BAU team must determine if the anniversary of the Kennedy assassination is a motivating factor when a sniper strikes Dallas.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S09 E04 — To Bear Witness
The BAU team meets the new section chief (Esai Morales), who shares a long history with J.J.; an unknown subject leaves victims unable to communicate.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S09 E05 — Route 66
As Hotch fights for his life after being stabbed, he has visions of his late wife and his nemesis; when a teen goes missing, suspicions arise about her estranged father.

title: The Listener
description:
S04 E13 — Fatal Vision
Toby struggles with PTSD after killing a suspect while the IIB attempts to stop an assassination.

title: The Listener
description:
S05 E01 — The Wrong Man
A serial killer imitates a past murderer; while on maternity leave, Michelle must return to the IIB in order to save her reputation.

title: The Listener
description:
S05 E02 — The Lockup
A former IIB colleague returns and ends up jeopardizing the team's success.

title: The Listener
description:
S05 E03 — Dancing With the Enemy
After a tip about a dance company, the team investigates the abduction of a ballerina.

title: Bull
description:
S01 E04 — Callisto
While helping a young woman fight a drug patent lawsuit, the team must travel to the small Texas town where Bull experienced the only trial loss of his career.

title: Bull
description:
S01 E05 — Just Tell the Truth
Bull defends the working class fiancé of a murdered socialite; Marissa, Cable and Danny ask Chunk to let them investigate a new guy he wants to date.

title: Bull
description:
S01 E06 — Bedside Manner
Bull has to find a way to reverse the negative effect of a surgeon with a God complex who is being sued for malpractice; Bull hires a previous client's attorney.

title: Bull
description:
S01 E07 — Never Saw the Sign
While assisting a man facing vehicular manslaughter charges, Bull finds a connection between the case and a state assemblyman who would benefit from a guilty verdict; Danny and Cable investigate why Marissa is acting and dressing differently.

title: Bull
description:
S01 E08 — Too Perfect
Bull attempts to assist his ex-wife's defense in a wrongful death lawsuit, but he's hindered by unresolved conflicts from their marriage and a longstanding rift with her brother.

title: Bull
description:
S01 E09 — Light My Fire
Bull faces his past when he returns to his childhood home to help with the defense of a young man accused of arson.

title: Bull
description:
S01 E10 — E.J.
Bull tries to help a CEO whose company is accused of killing an employee with its self-driving car, but a secret emerges that could sabotage a trial win.

title: Bull
description:
S01 E11 — Teacher's Pet
An attorney for one of Bull's former clients asks him to consult on a couple's civil suit against a teacher who had a sexual relationship with their son; the trial strategy suffers a major setback when the teen switches to the teacher's side.

title: Bones
description:
S09 E02 — The Cheat in the Retreat
The investigation into the murder of a management consultant whose remains were partially eaten by bobcats leads to a marriage retreat site; Cam's identity is stolen; Sweets decides to take a leave of absence.

title: Bones
description:
S09 E03 — El Carnicero en el Coche
The team investigates when a gang member's remains are found in a burnt-out car; when Sweets learns that one of the boys from the center where he volunteers is a gang member's son, he decides to help.

title: Bones
description:
S09 E04 — The Sense in the Sacrifice
The team devises a plan to use a donated cadaver to draw out Pelant; Sweets returns to work and believes Agent Flynn isn't who he seems.

title: Bones
description:
S09 E05 — The Lady on the List
The team investigates the murder of a high school principal who was dying of cancer; Brennan and Booth plan their wedding; a virtual profiling system threatens Sweets' job.

title: Bones
description:
S09 E06 — The Woman in White
The team tries to keep the details of an investigation away from Brennan so she will focus on her wedding; Max shows up with a suspicious bag of cash.

title: Bones
description:
S09 E07 — The Nazi on the Honeymoon
Unable to relax on their honeymoon, Booth and Brennan decide to help a local detective solve the murder of a Nazi war criminal; Hodgins and Angela look after Christine.

title: Bones
description:
S09 E08 — The Dude in the Dam
The team suspects that a man who made his money donating sperm was killed by a recipient who learned his records were inaccurate; Brennan enters a feud with a fellow author (Nora Dunn).

title: Bones
description:
S09 E09 — The Fury in the Jury
A key witness turns up dead in a case for which Brennan is a juror, so the team works to discover what has happened.

title: Bones
description:
S09 E10 — The Mystery in the Meat
The team investigates the murder of a food scientist whose body was put through a meat grinder and mixed into canned stew; Angela puts together a post-wedding bachelorette party for Brennan.

title: Bones
description:
S09 E11 — The Spark in the Park
When a gymnast's remains are found in a park, Booth and Brennan discover she was living a double life; Cam confronts the woman who stole her identity.

title: Bones
description:
S09 E12 — The Ghost in the Killer
The team investigates when the remains of a girl who died 18 years earlier are delivered to Brennan and Booth's house; Brennan dreams about Pelant.

title: Bones
description:
S09 E13 — Big in the Philippines
The team investigates the death of a country music singer whose remains were found in a shallow grave; Brennan takes a look at Wendell's injuries after he breaks his arm during a hockey game.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E01 — The Too Many Rembrandts Job
When the team comes together to help Sophie, they intercept guilt-ridden corporate fixer Harry and decide to help him take down an evil billionaire making money on the back of an opioid crisis.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E02 — The Panamanian Monkey Job
With a new team member on board, plus the arrival of Hardison's genius foster sister, the team heads to Panama to pull an elaborate heist before an evil billionaire can get his money and flee to a non-extradition country.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E03 — The Rollin' on the River Job
The Leverage team takes on a greedy riverboat casino owner, before he can bulldoze the homes of longtime New Orleans natives for his planned expansion.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E04 — The Tower Job
One member of the team seeks redemption and justice by convincing Leverage to con a developer out of an entire luxury apartment building.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E09 — Into the Woods
When an 8-year-old is found dead on the Appalachian Trail, the team searches the forests for a man targeting children.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E10 — What Happens at Home ...
The team pursues a killer who targets women; Hotchner turns to an FBI cadet for help.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E11 — 25 to Life
After helping a man get parole, Morgan regrets his decision when the man murders someone shortly after being released.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E12 — Corazon
A series of bizarre, ritualistic murders brings the team to Miami; Reid experiences hallucinations and blinding headaches.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E13 — The Thirteenth Step
The team pursues two young lovers on a killing spree; Prentiss receives frightening news.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E14 — Sense Memory
The team investigates unusual murders in Los Angeles, and more information about Prentiss' past arises.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E15 — Today I Do
The BAU heads to upstate New York to investigate mysterious disappearances; Prentiss receives troubling news about a former colleague.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E16 — Coda
Reid's ability to connect with an autistic child may prove helpful in finding the boy's missing parents; two former colleagues help Prentiss search for an old adversary.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E17 — Valhalla
After a series of murders, Prentiss becomes suspicious of a former nemesis (Sebastian Roché) and fears for the safety of her team.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E18 — Lauren
Prentiss prepares to confront her nemesis at last; the team asks J.J. to help find Prentiss and capture Doyle.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E19 — With Friends Like These ...
The team must stop a gang of suspected murderers that is targeting a new victim nightly.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E20 — Hanley Waters
The team must investigate targeted killings in Florida while each member is dealing with feelings about losing Prentiss.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E21 — The Stranger
A stalker in San Diego targets college students; Strauss scrutinizes the team after the loss of Prentiss.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E22 — Out of the Light
The team travels to a North Carolina town where one woman was found badly injured and another is missing, and discovers those may not be the only victims.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E23 — Big Sea
The team investigates when bodies are found buried beneath the ocean floor off Florida; Morgan is rattled when his aunt thinks her missing daughter is one of the victims.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E24 — Supply & Demand
The team investigates a suspected human trafficking ring; Hotchner suggests changes are coming; J.J. returns to the team.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E01 — It Takes a Village
A Senate committee questions the members of the BAU team; a familiar face may help keep the team united.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E02 — Proof
The BAU team investigates a series of murders in Oklahoma; Reid gives JJ and Prentiss the cold shoulder.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E03 — Dorado Falls
After a mass murder at an Internet security company, evidence indicates that the person responsible is not a typical serial killer; Prentiss is required to complete recertification training.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E04 — Painless
A killer targets survivors of a high-school massacre, who have gathered for a reunion; Hotch fears that his son is being bullied.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E12 — Loyalty + Family + Rogue + Hellfire
The team is forever altered when MacGyver's Aunt Gwen gets into his head and convinces Mac and Riley to join Codex; Matty and Russ take their concerns about Codex to the White House.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E13 — Save + The + Dam + World
Mac and Riley's mission is interrupted when Russ, Desi and the Phoenix team move to prevent Codex from detonating a weapon of mass destruction; the team discovers Russ' real reason for purchasing the Phoenix Foundation.

title: MacGyver
description:
S05 E01 — Resort + Desi + Riley + Window Cleaner + Witness
Mac and the team infiltrate a hotel used as a hideout for criminals and find a woman with vital information on Codex.

title: MacGyver
description:
S05 E02 — Thief + Painting + Auction + Viro-486 + Justice
When Taylor's former protégé is killed while preventing a bioweapon from falling into the wrong hands, Mac and the team must find the weapon, so Desi can pull off the ultimate heist before it's sold to a terrorist cell.

title: MacGyver
description:
S05 E03 — Eclipse + USMC-1856707 + Step Potential + Chain Lock + Ma
When Russ is kidnapped, Mac and the team must break out a previously murderous psychopath, now pacifist, from prison to help find him; while on the run, Mac and Desi are forced to confront their relationship issues.

title: MacGyver
description:
S05 E04 — Banh Bao + Sterno + Drill + Burner + Mason
Mac's meeting with Desi's parents goes sideways when her brother finds himself in trouble and needing their help; Russ and Matty must ask an old nemesis for assistance when their new recruitment candidate is kidnapped.
